items.title: October 2026 release notes
items.metaDescription: October updates cover product calendars, routing visibility, store operations, Shopify synchronization, returns, and Job Manager.

items.title: Manage product dates across the whole catalog
items.metaDescription: Search the full product calendar, update selected lifecycle dates, and review product identifiers and Shopify links.

items.title: See why an order moved and where stock is held
items.metaDescription: Connect order routing history, stock warnings, and routing diagnostics to investigate fulfillment decisions.

items.title: Keep store receiving and counts clear from scan to confirmation
items.metaDescription: Find transfers by tracking code, review uncertain receipts, and keep cycle-count progress and packed shipments visible.

items.title: Follow Shopify sync from transfer ownership to fulfillment
items.metaDescription: Review incomplete transfer sync, repair product mappings, and understand fulfillment and inventory reset recovery.

items.title: Keep return receipts and NetSuite records connected
items.metaDescription: Track physical return arrivals, respect per-item restocking, and carry return context into NetSuite reconciliation.

items.title: See both sides of a Shopify bulk operation
items.metaDescription: Compare Shopify processing with HotWax consumption, find shared-remote jobs, and manage existing system tasks.

items.title: Preview the new pre-order workspace
items.metaDescription: Explore the merged pre-order workspace and the future-inventory import contract while release acceptance continues.
